settings.heading: Assembly & Care
settings.content:
Most of our furniture is shipped disassembled to protect the wood during transit.

Built for Everyone: We pride ourselves on a "no-experience-needed" assembly system. It’s simple, fast, and literally anyone can do it.

Exceptions: To guarantee the best quality, certain products are shipped fully assembled, including chairs and small accent pieces.

Dual-Guide System: You’ll receive a written manual or/and a video tutorial via email as soon as you purchase.

Support: We are committed to your satisfaction. If you require any assistance during setup, please contact our support team: support@awefurni.com

settings.heading: Shipping & Return
settings.content:
Shipping Cost

All products are manufactured by our partners in Vietnam.
We offer free standard shipping on all orders shipped within the United States (No minimum purchase is required).
For products that offer an assembly choice, if you'd prefer your items to arrive fully assembled, you can select that option for an additional fee.

30 Day Return Policy

You have 30 days from your purchase date to initiate a return. To qualify, items must be unworn, unaltered, and in their original condition with all tags intact.

Please note: Returns are accepted for items that arrived damaged during transit or contain manufacturing defects.

settings.heading: Payment & Security
settings.description: Your payment information is processed securely. We do not store credit card details nor have access to your credit card information.

settings.header_text: See What Our Community Has To Say
See What Our Community Has To Say

settings.title: Mateo Nguyen
settings.text: He got obsessed with curves, how a single cut could turn a flat board into something that looked alive. He spent years building for other studios before he had the confidence to trust his own hand. At Awefurni, he leads the sculptural work.

settings.title: Daniel Tran
settings.text: He studied architecture, spent a few years drawing buildings he found boring, then walked into a furniture workshop one afternoon and didn't leave. What he brought from architecture was precision , he thinks in joints, in how two surfaces meet, in the invisible structure that holds a piece together for decades.

settings.title: Andre Lam
settings.text: Andre doesn't build furniture. He finishes it , and he'll be the first to tell you that's where a piece either comes to life or falls flat. At Awefurni, he selects the slabs, matches the grain across panels, and applies the finishes by hand. Natural Oak, Dark Walnut, Warm Walnut, every tone you see on the site went through Andre's hands.

settings.title: Tom Ly
settings.text:
Tom makes the pieces that are hard to explain in words, the abstract sculptures, the carved wall panels, the shapes that look like they belong in a gallery but somehow feel right in a living room.
Every organic edge table, every sculpted base, every triptych wall piece carries his eye for proportion.

settings.heading: Meet Our Wood Artists
settings.description: Every piece at Awefurni begins the same way - a slab of raw wood and a pair of hands that know what's inside it.

settings.heading: Are your products easy to install?
settings.content:
Yes. Our furniture is designed to be installed by most customers without professional help.

Each order includes access to a step-by-step instruction video, and the required hardware is provided. Installation time typically ranges from 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the product type and size.

For larger or more complex pieces, having a second person assist is recommended.

settings.heading: What materials do you use in your furniture?
settings.content:
100% Natural Solid Wood – Tailored to Your Order
All of our furniture is crafted from high-quality, responsibly sourced solid wood. We guarantee that your item will be made using the exact wood type you specify.

  • Customizable Wood Species: Choose from premium Ash, Oak, or Walnut.

Because material selection is customized by you, variations apply per product. For personalized assistance or recommendations on the best wood choice for your piece, please contact our consulting team before placing your order.

settings.heading: Will the furniture get termites?
settings.content:
No. We take multiple steps to protect our furniture from termites and environmental damage.

  • All wood is properly treated before production
  • A protective finishing and coating is applied to the completed product
  • Items are carefully packaged to prevent moisture exposure during shipping

When used indoors and maintained properly, our furniture is resistant to termites and mold.

settings.heading: How should I care for and maintain the furniture?
settings.content:
We include care and maintenance instructions with every order.

General recommendations include:

  • Regular dusting with a soft, dry cloth
  • Avoiding prolonged exposure to moisture or direct sunlight
  • Using gentle, wood-safe cleaning products

Proper care will help preserve the appearance and durability of your furniture for many years.

settings.heading: How heavy is the package?
settings.content:
Package weight depends on the product size and design.

Most shipments weigh between 22 and 100 pounds (10–45 kg).

Exact weight information can be requested before purchase if needed.

Please ensure someone is available to receive and move heavier packages upon delivery.

settings.heading: Do you offer customization options?
settings.content:
Yes. All products are custom-made.

We offer personalized design options, including size adjustments, layout modifications, and design refinements to suit your space and preferences. Our team will review your requirements and confirm feasibility before production begins.

settings.heading: Do you offer international shipping?
settings.content:
At this time, we ship only within the United States.

All products are manufactured by our partners in Vietnam and shipped internationally to U.S. addresses. We currently do not offer delivery to other countries.

settings.heading: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.content:
Because our products are custom-made, delivery time includes both production and shipping.

  • Production time: approximately 10–20 business days
  • Shipping time to the U.S.: approximately 10–25 business days

Estimated total delivery time: 20–45 business days from the order date.

Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number via email so you can follow its progress.

Please note that delivery times are estimates and may vary due to customs clearance, carrier delays, or peak seasons.

settings.heading: How much does shipping cost?
settings.content:
Shipping is free for all orders delivered within the United States.

There are no additional shipping fees charged at checkout.

Please note that customs duties or import-related fees, if applicable, are determined by local authorities and are the responsibility of the customer.

settings.heading: How do I track my order?
settings.content:
Once your order leaves our fulfillment partner, you will receive an email with your tracking number.

Please keep in mind:

  • Tracking may take 3–5 business days to become active
  • Updates may be limited while the package is in international transit

You can also track your order by visiting our website and navigating to the “Track Your Order” section. Enter your order number and email address or tracking number to view the latest status.

settings.heading: What payment options do you accept?
settings.content:
We accept the following secure payment methods at checkout:

  • Visa
  • Mastercard
  • American Express (AMEX)
  • Discover
  • Diners Club
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Shop Pay

All payments are processed securely through Shopify’s trusted payment system.
